title: SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.35501v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRBench, SRHarness consistently improves both numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones. With DeepSeek-v4-flash-0731,

tldr: SRHarness是一个面向智能体符号回归的领域专用运行时框架，通过可组合科学动作、持久化科学状态和轨迹生命周期管理三大机制，在相同大语言模型骨干下持续提升了数值泛化与符号恢复性能。
en_tdlr: SRHarness is a domain-specific runtime harness for agentic symbolic regression that, through composable scientific actions, persistent scientific state, and trajectory lifecycle management, consistently improves numerical generalization and symbolic recovery under matched LLM backbones.
